paragraphs: R' Yehudah ben Peturah. See the entry R' Yehudah ben Beteira.[^1]

notes.text: Peturah (פתורה) and Beteira (בתירה) remain distinct forms. The source does not specify which numbered ben Beteira entry is meant; no number is supplied here. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
